_about: Perf Tuner catalog. Every entry is a change the picture does not show: no resolution, quality level, upscaler, frame cap, LOD or mip bias can appear here; the tuner refuses the file if one does. Engine defaults quoted are Unreal 5.6.1's, read from the engine source; the game's own values are from its cooked DefaultEngine.ini and DefaultScalability.ini. Edit with the game closed.

tweaks.title: Texture pool
tweaks.what: Keeps more textures in video memory. Uses 22.5% of VRAM, capped at 3000 MB, on supported cards. Keeps a larger existing pool. Console priority prevents the texture-quality menu from changing this pool again until restart.

tweaks.title: Nanite streaming pool
tweaks.what: Keeps more geometry pages in video memory, with a 512 to 1024 MB pool based on VRAM. Geometry detail stays unchanged. Keeps a larger existing pool.

tweaks.title: Level-unload cleanup
tweaks.what: Defers forced garbage collection when a streamed level unloads. Regular cleanup still runs. May reduce loading hitches; retains unused objects longer.

tweaks.title: Garbage collection pacing
tweaks.what: Spaces object purges 120 seconds apart. Retains unused objects longer and can make each purge larger. A one-minute test cannot measure this reliably.

tweaks.title: Async Nanite shadows
tweaks.what: Runs Nanite shadow rendering on the compute queue to overlap GPU work. Keeps the same geometry and shadows. Tune tests whether it helps this card and driver.

tweaks.title: Nanite without mesh shaders
tweaks.what: Uses vertex shaders for Nanite rasterization under Proton. Keeps the same geometry. Tune compares both paths and keeps this only if it measures faster.

tweaks.title: Reflex off
tweaks.what: Disables NVIDIA Reflex without changing the picture. Can increase input latency. Tune keeps it off only if frame time improves.
